title: Keep windows closed during peak smog
text: Keep exterior windows and balcony doors sealed during worst AQI hours to prevent ambient particulate entry.
mechanism: Physical barrier against outdoor ambient PM2.5 infiltration.

title: Aerate briefly during the cleanest window
text: Open windows for 10-15 minutes only during the day's cleanest 3-hour window to exchange stale air.
mechanism: Exchanges indoor CO2 and moisture while minimizing pollutant intake.

title: Wet mop floors instead of dry sweeping
text: Use a damp cloth or wet mop on hard floors. Dry sweeping resuspends settled settled fine particulate matter.
mechanism: Traps settled particles without re-aerosolizing dust.

title: Avoid burning incense or mosquito coils
text: Burning incense, coils, or candles releases significant indoor PM2.5 and volatile organic compounds.

title: Run kitchen exhaust hood during cooking
text: Always operate exhaust ventilation while frying or sautéing to vent cooking emissions directly outside.
mechanism: Extracts oil droplet aerosols and combustion byproducts at the source.

title: Consider a low-cost DIY box fan filter
text: A standard box fan taped securely to a high-efficiency furnace filter provides effective indoor filtration.
mechanism: Recirculates room air across physical filter media.

title: Isolate rooms when running air filtration
text: Close interior bedroom doors to reduce the cubic volume your air purifier needs to circulate.
mechanism: Increases Clean Air Delivery Rate (CADR) per unit volume.
